lessons.name: Buying a Ticket
lessons.description: Trains and coaches: buy tickets, read the timetable and talk about departures.

multiple_choice.name: Match the ticket words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A ticket for Plovdiv
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Един билет за Пловдив, моля." means "One ticket to Plovdiv, please."

true_false.name: True or false: Peron
true_false.sentence: "Перон" is a railway platform.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Влакът тръгва от втори перон" means "The train leaves from platform two".

fill_in_the_blank.name: The train will leave
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Влакът за Варна __ в осем и половина.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Влакът за Варна ще тръгне в осем и половина." means "The train to Varna will leave at half past eight."

fill_in_the_blank.name: I bought the tickets
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера купих билетите по интернет." means "Yesterday I bought the tickets online."

true_false.name: True or false: Razpisanie
true_false.sentence: "Разписание" means "receipt".
true_false.explanation: An разписание is a timetable. A receipt is a "касова бележка".

multiple_choice.name: Match the journey words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A twenty-minute delay
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Влакът има закъснение от двадесет минути." means "The train is twenty minutes late."

true_false.name: True or false: Avtogara
true_false.sentence: The main bus station in a Bulgarian town is the "автогара".
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is the bus version of гара (station).

fill_in_the_blank.name: Which carriage
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "В кой вагон е мястото ми?" means "Which carriage is my seat in?"

lessons.name: Verbs of Motion
lessons.description: Going, coming and returning around town, in the present, past and future.

multiple_choice.name: Match the motion verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I go to work by tram
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Всеки ден __ на работа с трамвай.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Всеки ден ходя на работа с трамвай." means "Every day I go to work by tram." A regular trip takes ходя.

true_false.name: True or false: Idvam and otivam
true_false.sentence: "Идвам" means coming towards the speaker, and "отивам" means going away from them.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Идваш ли?" is "Are you coming?", and "Отивам си" is "I am going home".

fill_in_the_blank.name: When will you be back
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ти кога ще се __ от почивка?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ти кога ще се върнеш от почивка?" means "When will you be back from holiday?"

fill_in_the_blank.name: We walked to the centre
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера отидохме пеша до центъра." means "Yesterday we walked to the centre."

true_false.name: True or false: Tragvam
true_false.sentence: "Тръгвам" means "to arrive".
true_false.explanation: "Тръгвам" means "to set off". "To arrive" is "пристигам".

multiple_choice.name: Match the route words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English preposition to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The tram comes often
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Трамваят минава на всеки десет минути." means "The tram comes every ten minutes." A regular event takes the present.

true_false.name: True or false: Otivam pesha
true_false.sentence: "Отивам пеша" means "I go on foot".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Пеша means "on foot".

fill_in_the_blank.name: How do I get to the station
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Как да стигна до гарата?" means "How do I get to the station?"

lessons.name: Taking a Taxi
lessons.description: Rides, luggage and short pronouns for "to me" and "to us".

multiple_choice.name: Match the taxi words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: He helped us
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Шофьорът ни помогна с куфарите." means "The driver helped us with the suitcases." Ни is the short form of "us".

true_false.name: True or false: Stoyanka
true_false.sentence: "Стоянка за таксита" is a taxi rank.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Стоянка is a place where vehicles wait.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We took a taxi
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера взехме такси до летището." means "Yesterday we took a taxi to the airport."

fill_in_the_blank.name: A receipt for me
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Може ли да __ дадете касова бележка?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли да ми дадете касова бележка?" means "Could you give me a receipt?" "To me" is ми.

true_false.name: True or false: Tarifa
true_false.sentence: "Тарифа" is the taxi driver's name tag.
true_false.explanation: A тарифа is the list of rates. Bulgarian taxis must show it on the window.

multiple_choice.name: Match the luggage words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: In the boot
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сложете куфара в багажника на колата." means "Put the suitcase in the boot of the car."

true_false.name: True or false: Kurs
true_false.sentence: A single taxi ride in Bulgarian is a "курс".
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Колко струва курсът?" means "How much is the ride?"

fill_in_the_blank.name: Your seat belt
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сложи си колана преди да тръгнем." means "Put on your seat belt before we set off."

lessons.name: At the Exchange Office
lessons.description: Change money, ask about rates and talk about spending and saving.

multiple_choice.name: Match the money words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I want to change dollars
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Искам да __ сто долара в евро.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Искам да обменя сто долара в евро." means "I want to change a hundred dollars into euro." One exchange takes the perfective.

true_false.name: True or false: Kurs meanings
true_false.sentence: "Курс" can mean an exchange rate and also a taxi ride.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It also means a course of study.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The dollar rate
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Какъв е курсът на долара днес?" means "What is the dollar rate today?" The subject takes the full article -ът.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two percent commission
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Бюрото взема комисиона от два процента." means "The office charges a two percent commission."

true_false.name: True or false: Moneta
true_false.sentence: "Монета" is a banknote.
true_false.explanation: A монета is a coin. A banknote is a "банкнота".

multiple_choice.name: Match the money verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: All my money
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Похарчих всичките си пари за подаръци." means "I spent all my money on presents."

true_false.name: True or false: Pari
true_false.sentence: The word "пари" (money) is plural in Bulgarian.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Парите са в портфейла" means "The money is in the wallet".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Lend me ten euro
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Можеш ли да ми __ десет евро до петък?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Можеш ли да ми дадеш назаем десет евро до петък?" means "Can you lend me ten euro until Friday?"

lessons.name: Checking In at a Hotel
lessons.description: Book a room, check in and sort out problems at reception.

multiple_choice.name: Match the hotel words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A booking for two nights
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имам резервация за две нощувки." means "I have a booking for two nights."

true_false.name: True or false: Noshtuvka
true_false.sentence: "Нощувка" means one night's stay.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Нощувка със закуска" is bed and breakfast.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Breakfast is included
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Закуската е включена в цената." means "Breakfast is included in the price."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Could you give me the key
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Извинете, бихте ли ми __ ключа от стаята?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Бихте ли ми дали ключа от стаята?" means "Could you give me the room key?" Бихте ли is followed by the -л form.

true_false.name: True or false: Dvoyna staya
true_false.sentence: A "двойна стая" is a room for one person.
true_false.explanation: A двойна стая is a double room. A single room is an "единична стая".

multiple_choice.name: Match the hotel problems
pairs: When must I leave the room?
До колко часа трябва да освободя стаята?
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English sentence to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The air conditioning is broken
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Климатикът в стаята ни не __ от вчера.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Климатикът в стаята ни не работи от вчера." means "The air conditioning in our room has not worked since yesterday."

true_false.name: True or false: Retseptsiya
true_false.sentence: At a hotel, the "рецепция" is where you check in.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The person there is the "рецепционист".

fill_in_the_blank.name: We will leave the room
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ще освободим стаята до 12 часа утре." means "We will check out of the room by 12 tomorrow."

lessons.name: A Trip to Veliko Tarnovo
lessons.description: Plan a trip to the old capital with the future tense.

multiple_choice.name: Match the trip words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We will go on a trip
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Утре __ на екскурзия до Велико Търново.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Утре ще отидем на екскурзия до Велико Търново." means "Tomorrow we will go on a trip to Veliko Tarnovo."

true_false.name: True or false: Tsarevets
true_false.sentence: The Tsarevets fortress stands on a hill in Veliko Tarnovo.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It was the stronghold of the medieval Bulgarian tsars.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The guide will show us
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Екскурзоводът ще ни покаже крепостта." means "The guide will show us the fortress."

fill_in_the_blank.name: The Yantra flows
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Река Янтра тече през града." means "The Yantra river flows through the town."

true_false.name: True or false: Ekskurzovod
true_false.sentence: "Екскурзовод" means "tour bus".
true_false.explanation: An екскурзовод is a tour guide.

multiple_choice.name: Match the future phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We will not be late
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Няма да се върнем късно." means "We will not be back late." The negative future is "няма да".

true_false.name: True or false: Sound and light
true_false.sentence: Tsarevets sometimes hosts an evening sound and light show.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The show "Звук и светлина" lights up the fortress in colour.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We will walk
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако времето е хубаво, __ пеша до крепостта.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако времето е хубаво, ще вървим пеша до крепостта." means "If the weather is good, we will walk to the fortress."

lessons.name: Plovdiv's Old Town
lessons.description: Revival houses, Roman ruins and the arts district, told in the past tense.

multiple_choice.name: Match the old town words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Beautiful Revival houses
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Старият град е пълен с красиви __ къщи.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Старият град е пълен с красиви възрожденски къщи." means "The old town is full of beautiful Revival-era houses."

true_false.name: True or false: Capital of Culture
true_false.sentence: Plovdiv was a European Capital of Culture in 2019.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It was the first Bulgarian city to hold the title.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We saw the theatre
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера разгледахме Античния театър." means "Yesterday we looked round the Ancient Theatre."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Cobbled streets
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Улиците са покрити с __ и са стръмни.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Улиците са покрити с калдъръм и са стръмни." means "The streets are cobbled and steep."

true_false.name: True or false: Kaldaram
true_false.sentence: "Калдъръм" is a type of Bulgarian cheese.
true_false.explanation: Калдъръм is cobblestone paving, typical of old towns.

multiple_choice.name: Match the Plovdiv sights
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each description to the Bulgarian name.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Seven hills
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Според легендата Пловдив е построен на седем __ край реката.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...Пловдив е построен на седем хълма" means "...Plovdiv was built on seven hills." After a number, хълм becomes хълма.

true_false.name: True or false: Kapana
true_false.sentence: "Капана" is an arts district of Plovdiv full of cafés and galleries.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Its name means "the trap", after its maze of little streets.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I will send you photos
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ще ти изпратя снимки от Пловдив." means "I will send you photos from Plovdiv."

lessons.name: Sightseeing
lessons.description: Museums, churches and monuments: opening hours, tickets and visits.

multiple_choice.name: Match the sightseeing words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Which sights
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кои забележителности видя в София?" means "Which sights did you see in Sofia?"

true_false.name: True or false: Alexander Nevsky
true_false.sentence: The Alexander Nevsky Cathedral is in Sofia.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is one of the largest Orthodox cathedrals in the Balkans.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Closed on Mondays
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Музеят е затворен в понеделник." means "The museum is closed on Mondays."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Taking photos
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Може ли да се __ в църквата?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли да се снима в църквата?" means "Is it allowed to take photos in the church?" Се + third person makes an impersonal question.

true_false.name: True or false: Pametnik
true_false.sentence: "Паметник" means "museum".
true_false.explanation: A паметник is a monument. A museum is a "музей".

multiple_choice.name: Match the visitor words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Free entry
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Входът за студенти е __ в сряда.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Входът за студенти е безплатен в сряда." means "Entry for students is free on Wednesdays." Вход is masculine.

true_false.name: True or false: Rabotno vreme
true_false.sentence: "Работно време" means opening hours.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "working time".

fill_in_the_blank.name: We visited the monastery
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Миналата година посетихме Рилския манастир." means "Last year we visited the Rila Monastery."

lessons.name: A Seaside Holiday
lessons.description: A holiday on the Black Sea, before, during and after.

multiple_choice.name: Match the holiday words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We will holiday in Sozopol
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Това лято ние ще __ на море в Созопол.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Това лято ние ще почиваме на море в Созопол." means "This summer we will holiday by the sea in Sozopol."

true_false.name: True or false: Shezlong
true_false.sentence: A "шезлонг" is a sunbed on the beach.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It comes from the French "chaise longue".

fill_in_the_blank.name: The water was warm
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Миналото лято водата беше много топла." means "Last summer the water was very warm."

fill_in_the_blank.name: The lifeguard watches the beach
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Спасителят пази плажа цял ден." means "The lifeguard watches over the beach all day."

true_false.name: True or false: Pochivka
true_false.sentence: "Почивка" means "work".
true_false.explanation: A почивка is a holiday or a rest.

multiple_choice.name: Match the beach verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I got sunburnt
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вчера __ на слънце и сега ме боли гърбът.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера изгорях на слънце и сега ме боли гърбът." means "Yesterday I got sunburnt and now my back hurts."

true_false.name: True or false: Na more
true_false.sentence: Bulgarians say "отивам на море" for going on a seaside holiday.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Note there is no article: на море, like на почивка.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The children swam
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вчера децата __ в морето цял следобед.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера децата плуваха в морето цял следобед." means "Yesterday the children swam in the sea all afternoon."

lessons.name: When Things Go Wrong
lessons.description: Lost passports, missed trains and asking for help.

multiple_choice.name: Match the trouble words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I lost my passport
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Изгубих паспорта си на летището." means "I lost my passport at the airport."

true_false.name: True or false: 112
true_false.sentence: The emergency number in Bulgaria is 112.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It works for police, ambulance and fire across the EU.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Someone stole my wallet
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Някой открадна портфейла ми!" means "Someone has stolen my wallet!"

fill_in_the_blank.name: The flight is delayed
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Полетът ни е __ с три часа.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Полетът ни е отложен с три часа." means "Our flight is delayed by three hours." Полет is masculine.

true_false.name: True or false: Posolstvo
true_false.sentence: "Посолство" means "police station".
true_false.explanation: A посолство is an embassy. A police station is a "полицейско управление".

multiple_choice.name: Match the emergency phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English sentence to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I missed the train
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Изпуснах __ и трябва да чакам следващия.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Изпуснах влака и трябва да чакам следващия." means "I missed the train and have to wait for the next one."

true_false.name: True or false: Barza pomosht
true_false.sentence: "Бърза помощ" is an ambulance.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "quick help".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Help me find my hotel
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Моля, помогнете __ да намеря хотела си.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Моля, помогнете ми да намеря хотела си." means "Please help me find my hotel." Помагам takes "to me": ми.
